language.name: English
page.reconnecting: Connection to the server lost. Reconnecting…
page.syncing: Still reading the cluster. More tiles may appear.
page.stale: Not connected to {clusters}. Showing the last known tiles, if any.
page.empty: There are no applications or bookmarks to show yet.
page.newerProtocol: The server speaks a newer protocol. Reload the page.
tile.noLink: This tile has no usable link.
search.title: Search applications and bookmarks
search.placeholder: Search, or type ? to search the web
search.hint: ↑↓ to move, Enter to open, Esc to close
settings.title: Settings
settings.background.imageUrlHelp: An http or https address of an image.
settings.shortcuts.search: Open search, or just start typing
settings.handwrittenFontHelp: A casual handwritten typeface for the whole page.
settings.presets.help: A preset remembers the layout and the background.
settings.presets.name: Preset name
settings.background.timeGradientHelp: A gradient that follows the day: deep blue at night, pink at sunrise, pastels in the morning, bright blue in the afternoon and gold at sunset.
settings.background.patternSeedHelp: Change the text to get a different pattern.
settings.background.meshAnimatedHelp: Moves slowly. Stays still when your system asks for reduced motion.
settings.background.overlayHelp: From solid white on the left, through none in the middle, to solid black on the right. A white panel goes with the light theme and a black one with the dark theme, so changing one changes the other.
settings.hoverEffect: Highlight the tile under the pointer
settings.clusters.help: Show the applications and bookmarks of these clusters.
settings.clusters.unreachable: Not reachable; showing the last known tiles
settings.combine: Combine the same service on several clusters into one card
settings.byClusterHelp: Each cluster's applications and bookmarks are listed under its name. Nothing is combined then.
settings.combineHelp: Each cluster then gets a pill on the card that links to it.
clusters.hint: Click to show only this cluster, again to show all. Shift- or Ctrl-click to add or remove it.
unlock.title: Unlock editing
unlock.help: With the edit key of this instance you can add, change and delete applications and bookmarks. The key is kept in this browser until you lock the page again.
unlock.wrong: That is not the edit key.
unlock.limited: Too many attempts with a wrong key. Try again in a moment.
unlock.failed: The key could not be checked. Try again.
edit.where.new: It is created in the namespace {namespace}.
edit.urlFrom: The address is read from the {kind} {name}. The one given here is used while that cannot be read.
edit.error.locked: The edit key is no longer valid. Unlock the page again.
edit.error.unreachable: The server could not be reached. Try again.
edit.field.name: Name
edit.help.icon: An Iconify name such as mdi:home, or the address of a picture.
edit.help.iconColor: A colour name or a hex value, for icons that take one.
edit.help.tags: Separated by commas. A tagged tile shows only on addresses that name one of its tags.
edit.help.location: Lower comes first within the group.
